long_biography.plain_text:
At Institute of Life, Paris G. Alexandridis provides the business leadership within a medical team. He became a shareholder in 2016 and took responsibility for marketing, growth and financial management at the Athens fertility centre. As the team's economist and entrepreneur, he gives its clinical specialists a dedicated commercial and financial counterpart.

He came to that role after Athens College, an economics degree at New York University's Stern School of Business and a master's in risk management from City University London. Outside his companies, he has supported Skiathos through practical local projects. Responding to a municipal request, he donated a compact ambulance able to navigate roads too narrow for standard emergency vehicles. It was assigned to serve the island's health centre.
